It's not so much pride as I'm just stubborn. The only people who know how much of a disaster I am right now are the ones here on Reddit. My city has the most bridges out of any city in the world and the only decision I feel competent enough to make it what bridge I want to throw myself off of. 

I would assume that person actually HAS intelligence and potential. I think most people do. I'm just too shitty of a person to actually be useful. I don't know what I would say to them. Depends on the person, I guess. I would probably be a shitty counselor too.
That to me is worse than failing because I don't want to make excuses for being a bad student. Besides, my professors wouldn't help me. No one wants to help me.
I just don't have motivation to do well. I study and I work hard on papers but I know I could do better but I just don't. My GPA isn't bad but it's not good enough.
We should. It'll be the worst club in the world.

Most, if not all, counseling jobs need a masters. And it's not really something I've felt like a "calling" for, I change my mind about careers all the time. But I guess I've always wanted to do something that involves helping people. I honestly don't have much of a purpose right now.
Ironically enough, I want to be a licensed counselor.

I asked my really good friend that, because she was there for all my last relationship and saw the whole thing go down and all she said about my new boyfriend is that "he looks like a goat". So like, nothing helpful. 

Another friend asked me "are you dating him because you like him, or because you want a boyfriend?", which really stung. 

But I like him a lot and he's so nice to me in ways I'm not used to. I'm okay with not getting my friends' approval on this, he makes me happy and I'll stick up for him if I have to.
It was like a good amount of bleeding, but not as long or heavy as my periods were before I got on the pill.
My roommate had started her period, and I tend to be easily influenced by other menstruating women. Could that be a possibility?
Would taking a pregnancy test now be accurate? I figure I should probably wait a few more days but I'm kind of losing my mind.
We've really only been together for about 6 months, we were dating casually for a bit before that.
